name: Knyha v brunatniy paliturtsi

FOR INTERNAL USE

This presentation is the property of the Special Department 'Ultraviolet' of the Security Service of Ukraine.

Note: The Brown Book is a 'Metnal' artifact and access to it must be approved by at least two 'Ultraviolet' operatives.
